results.title: Wonder Beast
results.overview: With fairy-tale inhabitants, everything is the same as with people - when a marriage breaks up, Resentment remains... That is the name of the daughter of the powerful magicians Bolotnitsa and Chernogor, who divorced but continue to share power over the child. On the day of Resentment's coming of age, it turns out that she is deprived of the magical power that was supposed to be inherited from her parents. To fix the situation, Resentment urgently needs to find a groom in the human world, have a wedding and sacrifice the person - turn him into a tree... Together with Resentment, her mysterious friend, Chudo Yudo, goes to the human world. He can transform into anyone: a bird, an animal, and even a handsome prince.

results.title: Women as Lovers
results.overview: Although hostess Brigitte and life-loving schoolgirl Paula only meet in person once, their fates and lives are closely intertwined.

results.title: Die andere Seite
results.overview: Since losing her family, a woman is living alone in the wilderness — far away from society, which is dominated by mistrust and fear after the outbreak of a fatal disease. When she is forced to leave this life behind, she not only experiences a boundless freedom, but also remembers the importance of human closeness and the feeling of belonging.

results.title: The Lord of Cold
results.overview: Sisters Maria and Anastasia are best friends, and they cope not only with a grumpy mother, but also with ancient magic, because of which winter has not come in their village for many decades. The girls manage to overcome all obstacles, drive away the evil witch, melt the heart of the Lord of Cold, and also find love.

results.title: La venganza del Charro Negro
results.overview: The return of Leo San Juan and all the legends.

results.title: Solstice
results.overview: The disruption of an isolated rural town's tradition sends siblings Kaid and Caroline out of their town on a path that's subject to troubling rumours and haunted legends that warn against those who walk along it.

results.title: Kalkutún, Trial of the Witches
results.overview: In 1880, an inexperienced prosecutor must indict a group of people accused of witchcraft and murder on the island of Chiloé. Meanwhile, a young peasant girl, to save her grandfather from the condemnation of the state, must be initiated into witchcraft.

results.title: The Lost Mariachis
results.overview: Blending road movie, archival footage, and essayistic elements, this documentary chronicles a filmmaker's journey through the Balkans in search of the last Yu-Mex singers. Through a lost film by Emilio "El Indio" Fernández, this bittersweet story takes a playful approach in exploring how cinema and music migrate and are reinterpreted in distant contexts.

results.title: Beautiful Pain
results.overview: Amidst a contentious divorce, a single mother secures an unexpected breakthrough in the film industry to establish financial independence, only to face institutional workplace hazards and a predatory custody battle orchestrated by her former spouse.

results.title: Overman
results.overview: Overman, a fading superhero, takes a job with the government's Department of Public Security in an attempt to get back on his feet. While working alongside Pâmela, his loyal partner who is beginning to gain as much recognition as he has, Overman confronts his toxic masculinity and uncovers dark secrets involving the governor. Now, he must face his inner demons and an old enemy to prevent the city from plunging into irreversible chaos.

results.title: To the Victory!
results.overview: A dystopian story set in post-war Ukraine, where a frustrated film director struggles to make the most of his life after being denied the opportunity to pursue his movie-making career. Estranged from his wife and daughter, who have been living in Vienna and are reluctant to return to their war-torn nation, the director tries to find solace in his conviction that the difficult times will pass and life will return to normal.

results.title: Titans
results.overview: Small-time gangster Antony Yakuza teams up with young programmer Anwar to pull off a major heist, with mysterious driver Rejimon joining them. But Rejimon is not who he seems, and their simple crime soon turns into a strange, unpredictable journey where reality itself begins to blur.

results.title: Bon Voyage
results.overview: A stressful moment at a bus station leads 27-year-old Fairouz to meet a stranger who will change her view of human relationships.

results.title: La taquigrafista
results.overview: In 1976, during Argentina’s last military dictatorship, 17 Mercedes-Benz workers were forcibly disappeared. Only a few documents from their story have survived: some photographs taken by their coworkers, a fragment of a silent film, and documents written by police spies who had infiltrated the factory with the complicity of the company’s board of directors. Among these archives is an image of three women whose first names and occupations can only be guessed at: stenographers. Mari, one of them, is the recipient of a letter that weaves a tale of her past amid the fog of a present marked by the factory’s closure, after seventy years in the Buenos Aires suburbs.

results.title: Muiyukuna: Relatos de la chagra viva
results.original_title: Muiyukuna: Relatos de la chagra viva
results.overview: “An intimate work that transforms the voices of the Ticuna elders into a realm of memory. Through the story of origins and the relationship with the land, *Muiyukuna* champions oral tradition as a living form of knowledge and invites us to listen to the chagra not as a landscape, but as memory, origin, and the subject of collective existence,” says Adriana Jacanamejoy

results.title: Lulan
results.overview: A TNVS driver receives an unusual pickup order which later reveals secrets from the past.
